instruction: Create a Golden AMI pipeline using Packer and GitHub Actions
output:
echo 'name: build-ami
on: push
jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - run: packer init . - run: packer build -var-file=prod.pkrvars.hcl template.pkr.hcl' > .github/workflows/packer.yml

instruction: Use the amazon-chroot builder to create an AMI from an existing instance
Set up a CI pipeline for Windows AMI building
output: echo 'job: build-win: runs-on: windows-latest steps: - run: choco install packer - run: packer build win-template.pkr.hcl' > win-ci.yml

instruction: Use a post-processor to export AMI as a VM image
Export a GCP image to a storage bucket
Import a RAW image into AWS as an AMI
Create an Azure managed image from Packer
Create a shared image gallery version in Azure
output: echo 'source "azure-arm" "ubuntu" { shared_image_gallery { subscription = var.arm_subscription resource_group = "sig-rg" gallery_name = "myGallery" image_name = "ubuntu" image_version = "1.0.0" } }' > azure-sig.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a VHD in Azure from Packer
Tag the Azure managed image with metadata
output: echo 'build { sources = ["source.azure-arm.ubuntu"] provisioner "shell" { inline = ["echo built"] } post-processor "azure-arm-tag" { tags = { Environment = "prod" Version = var.version } } }' > azure-tag.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use the azure-arm builder with temporary resource group
Create a DigitalOcean snapshot via Packer
Build an image and automatically tag it with git commit
output: echo 'locals { git_sha = env("GITHUB_SHA") } source "amazon-ebs" "ubuntu" { tags = { Commit = local.git_sha } }' > git-tag.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a CI check that validates Packer templates
Build and push a Docker image in one Packer template
output: echo 'source "docker" "app" { image = "ubuntu:22.04" commit = true } build { sources = ["source.docker.app"] provisioner "shell" { inline = ["apt update && apt install -y nginx"] } post-processors { post-processor "docker-tag" { repository = "registry.example.com/app" tags = ["latest"] } post-processor "docker-push" {} } }' > docker-push.pkr.hcl

instruction: Export a Docker image and import as AWS AMI
output: echo 'source "docker" "app" { image = "nginx:latest" commit = true } build { post-processor "docker-save" { output = "nginx.tar" } post-processor "amazon-import" { s3_bucket_name = "import-bucket" } }' > docker-to-ami.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use a Terraform provisioner to apply infra during build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve"] }' > terraform-provisioner.pkr.hcl

instruction: Run a Packer build from a CI/CD pipeline with versioned AMIs
List all the AMIs created by a specific Packer template
Deregister old AMIs based on a Packer template tag
output: aws ec2 describe-images --owners self --filters 'Name=tag:Template,Values=ubuntu-base' --query 'Images[*].ImageId' --output text | xargs -n1 aws ec2 deregister-image --image-id

instruction: Clean up old Packer build snapshots in AWS
output: aws ec2 describe-snapshots --owner self --filters 'Name=description,Values=*packer*' --query 'Snapshots[*].SnapshotId' --output text | xargs -n1 aws ec2 delete-snapshot --snapshot-id

instruction: Build an image with Packer in parallel across regions
Set up a scheduled Packer build via cron
output: echo '0 2 * * 0 cd /infra/packer && packer build -var-file=prod.pkrvars.hcl template.pkr.hcl' | crontab -

instruction: Build with debug and pause after each step for inspection
Use Packer with a Vault token for dynamic secrets
output: VAULT_TOKEN=$(vault token create -ttl=1h -field=token) packer build template.pkr.hcl
